versions.title: The Infernal Court

skins.name: Cinder King
skins.story: He sits on a throne of cooling slag and wears a crown forged from the swords of every champion he burned.

skins.name: Horned Tyrant
skins.story: The pit grew him two black horns for every arena he conquered, and the molten grin never leaves his face.

skins.name: Ash Widow
skins.story: She wears a veil of black lace for every rival she outlived, and her violet fire burns colder than grief.

versions.note: The villains of the pit crown their own rulers: a king of cinders, a horned tyrant and a widow in violet flame who mourns nobody.

versions.title: Chains of the Pit

skins.name: Chain Warden
skins.story: He locked his own head in an iron cage so no prisoner could ever see him blink, and he never loses a key.

skins.name: Brimstone Executioner
skins.story: Nobody has seen the face under his hood, only the sulfur light in his eyes and the burning axe scar on his back.

skins.name: Shackled Beast
skins.story: The pit kept it chained for a hundred years, and the day it broke free it kept the shackles as trophies.

versions.note: Below the infernal court lies the prison of the pit, where a warden, an executioner and the beast they never tamed wait for new challengers.

versions.title: The Black Eclipse

skins.name: Eclipse Prophet
skins.story: He wears the dead sun on his brow and reads the end of every duel in the runes that burn down his robe.

skins.name: Soulfire Revenant
skins.story: Even the pit could not keep him dead; now cold blue soulfire burns where his heart and eyes used to be.

skins.name: Obsidian Juggernaut
skins.story: Forged out of a cooled lava flow, he walks through arrows and fireballs alike, and the magma inside him never sets.

versions.note: When the sun goes dark over the battlefield, the oldest villains rise: a prophet of the eclipse, a revenant of cold soulfire and an obsidian juggernaut.
